summary: Read-only. The built-in Reader role is enough for the scan, including Key Vault item names and who has access.
assign_at: each subscription to scan, or a management group above them
sign_in: az login   (or set AZURE_CLIENT_ID, AZURE_TENANT_ID and AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET for a service principal)

key_vault.reads: secret, key and certificate NAMES and status (enabled, expiry), vault access policies, Key Vault role assignments, and which app settings reference which secret
key_vault.never_reads: secret values, key material, certificate contents or app setting values
key_vault.note: Listing items and role assignments works with Reader. The app Key Vault reference status may need more than Reader; if it is denied the scan reports it as an unreadable area and carries on. Use --skip-keyvault to skip all of this.
